title: Mean--Variance Portfolio Selection by Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning: Algorithms, Regret Analysis, and Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2412.16175v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study continuous-time mean--variance portfolio selection in markets where stock prices are diffusion processes driven by observable factors that are also diffusion processes, yet the coefficients of these processes are unknown. Based on the recently developed reinforcement learning (RL) theory for diffusion processes, we present a general data-driven RL approach that learns the pre-committed investment strategy directly without attempting to learn or estimate the market coefficients. For multi-stock Black--Scholes markets without factors, we further devise an algorithm and prove its performance guarantee by deriving a sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio. translated_title: 基于连续时间强化学习的均值-方差投资组合选择：算法、遗憾分析与实证研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究连续时间均值-方差投资组合选择问题，考虑的市场中股票价格是由可观测因子（其本身也是扩散过程）驱动的扩散过程，但这些过程的系数是未知的。基于最近发展的扩散过程强化学习（RL）理论，我们提出了一种通用的数据驱动RL方法，直接学习预先承诺的投资策略，而无需尝试学习或估计市场系数。对于无因子的多股票Black-Scholes市场，我们进一步设计了一种算法，并通过推导以夏普比率表示的次线性遗憾界来证明其性能保证。随后，我们开展了广泛的实证研究，实现该算法并将其性能与交易特征（在多种常用指标下评估）同大量被广泛采用的投资组合配置策略在标普500成分股上进行比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于连续时间强化学习的数据驱动方法用于均值-方差投资组合选择，无需估计未知的市场系数即可直接学习投资策略，在多股票Black-Scholes市场中证明了以夏普比率衡量的次线性遗憾界，并通过在标普500成分股上的广泛实证研究验证了算法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven continuous-time reinforcement learning approach for mean-variance portfolio selection that directly learns the pre-committed investment strategy without estimating unknown market coefficients, proves a sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets, and validates the algorithm through an extensive empirical study on S&P 500 constituents.
